description:
Fast, one-line-per-finding PR review. Severity-tagged, no praise, no scope creep. Written in the Nimbus caveman format so the output stays scannable.
Trigger this skill when: - User says "review this PR", "review the diff", "audit this file", or invokes
  `/pr-review`.
- After a `gh pr diff` or a `git diff` the user pastes. - Before merging a PR the user wants a second opinion on.
